description: Read one TakeMeUp.cv guide in full by its slug: the short answer, sections, how-to steps, FAQs and sources, in the user's language when a translation exists. Use after listing or searching guides, to quote or summarise one.

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

slug.description: The guide slug, e.g. "cv-photo-by-country" (from list/search results).

name: get_takemeup_guide
